name: Filaments / breathing strands
description: Every strand sways and ripples continuously while its thickness breathes. Individual phases keep the movement from pulsing in unison.

name: Filaments / liquid strands
description: A more expressive version: broader moving bulges, stronger lateral waves, and fewer strands to give the motion room.

name: Filaments / contour script
description: Tapered ivory and blue strokes curl around the scene. Varied lengths and quieter shadows open space between the marks.

name: Filaments / silk tide
description: Longer copper and teal threads carry a traveling glint. A slow field turns the threads; no trails accumulate.

name: Paper / deeper stage
description: Larger cobalt, red, and rose cutouts with soft cast shadows, lit edges, and smooth independent layer motion.

name: Paper / nocturne
description: The same sculpted paper stage in petrol blue, muted jade, copper, and warm paper.

name: Filaments / original
description: The original luminous filaments, retained for comparison.

name: Paper / original
description: The original paper theatre, retained for comparison.
